77fd8118-61b0-4b1f-95a6-2b839d754f81.title: Tensei Shitara Ken deshita
77fd8118-61b0-4b1f-95a6-2b839d754f81.description: When he realized it, the protagonist was in another world and had become a sword that was stabbed on an altar in a great plain, crowded with devil beast. The world he was in had a game like system; HP, MP, Strength, Vitality, Agility, Intelligence, Dexterity, Titles and Equipment. Following his instinct as a living sword, he traveled to find the one who could be his wielder, until he met with a cat girl that was about to be attacked by a bear type devil beast.

18543708-eed6-4b84-b3fd-f67540b4ebbd.description:
**From Toriyama's World:**  
Yaiba's whole life has been spent training to be a samurai and he doesn't know about anything else, not even girls. When he returns to Japan, a pair of cursed swords makes life even more exciting… and hilarious.  
  
Note: Starting at chapter 80, EMS Team started using bunko scans, so the volume numbering is a little different.  
  
---
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award in 1993**

- Published in Indonesian by Elex Media Komputindo as **Yaiba**

07125c94-dc35-4064-a676-2cea158a55d6.altTitle: The Jack-of-All-Trades Kicked Out of the Hero's Party: The Swordsman Who Became a Support Mage Due to Party Circumstances, Becomes All-Powerful
07125c94-dc35-4064-a676-2cea158a55d6.description: Being a "Jack-of-all-trades" is a sin!? Despite trying his hardest, he's been told that he's out of a job!! A member of the Hero's party, Orun, is suddenly told by the party leader; "You're insufficient, you need to leave." Additionally, Orun is mocked by his former comrades as a "Jack-of-All-Trades, Master of None". True, he is well-rounded with no particular skill standing out. Still, he would complete every task with a skillful hand, what's more, he always performed at peak performance...! Orun, having grown frustrated, began working solo. However, deep within his heart lay the drive to become the ultimate "Jack-of-All-Trades, Master of None", an "All-Rounder"!

72431270-43ab-43cf-88c2-0c138391b1f4.title: Waves Upon Waves
72431270-43ab-43cf-88c2-0c138391b1f4.description:
there's an old legend in Sereong's family: their flute 'Manpa' will turn into a person if you care for it with enough love! But Sereong doesn't believe in this legend and plans to sell Manpa.... But it was then when Manpa turns into a human and tells Sereong he can grant her wish.

A romance between one who grants miracles and one who doesn't believe in miracles.

fa4816db-6ea5-4183-81e5-08495557eb91.description:
Ao Minato killed his abusive step father and entered a juvenile reformatory. However, his youngest sister who he had tried to protect committed suicide, and his older sister Akane has gone missing. Ao, who stumbled upon a weird shrine, wished for the safety of his sister, which is the only hope he has left, and swears to God that he will do anything for that...

eadb9e8c-07e0-4889-863e-4960bd43024b.description: At the popular Japanese-style tea house Rokuhoudou, customers can count on receiving not only excellent food and drink, but - if they wish for it - a helping hand in solving any problem that may be plaguing them. Serving in Rokuhoudou are four men who are consummate professionals in their individual fields: tea expert Sui, barista Gure, pâtissier Tsubaki and chef Tokitaka.

dc481ed5-4925-4f3c-bac1-e73f1e7ed338.title: Mushoku Tensei ~Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu~ Shitsui no Majutsushi Hen
dc481ed5-4925-4f3c-bac1-e73f1e7ed338.altTitle: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation - Depressed Magician
dc481ed5-4925-4f3c-bac1-e73f1e7ed338.description:
After separating from Eris, Rudeus falls into the depths of depression. He travels to Rozenberg, the second city of the Principality of Basherant, to search for his missing mother, Zenith. Desperate, Rudeus tries to accept a high-ranking quest alone in order to make a name for himself. However, by chance, he ends up working with a party of B-rank adventurers called the Counter Arrow. One of the party members is a girl named Sara, who reminds him of Eris…!
___
**Character Designer:** [Shirotaka](https://mangadex.org/author/38c0c039-c347-42fa-a196-3d0315451b4c)

**Note:** MangaDex follows the series's magazine chapter numbering, not the volume chapter numbering.
